# graphify

Turns code, docs, papers or media into a knowledge graph (interactive HTML, JSON, GRAPH_REPORT.md) you can query.

- Source: https://pypi.org/project/graphifyy/ (by safishamsi)
- Type: skill plus a CLI

```sh
uv tool install graphifyy   # or: pip install graphifyy
graphify install            # puts the skill in ~/.claude/skills/graphify
```

Use: `/graphify` in a repo. Output goes to `graphify-out/`.
